About Bang Tao

Bang Tao is a long beach on Phuket's west coast, in the Choeng Thale (Cherng Talay) subdistrict of Thalang district. Laguna Phuket, the resort community on Bang Tao Bay, has its own page in this catalogue; projects that sit inside Laguna Phuket are listed there rather than here, so no project is counted twice.

The projects on this page are in the Bang Tao beach area itself and span the whole range: affordable condominiums from about THB 2.9 million (The Title Sierra, The Zero Bang Tao, The Modeva), completed and pre-sale condominiums such as The Title Legendary and Heritage and PURITA, and high-end pool-villa communities (Mono Oxygen, Redwood Lakeside, Sri Panwa Lagoon). Bang Tao Beach is 1.9 km from The Zero Bang Tao in the project data, and Boat Avenue, Porto de Phuket and international schools appear in the nearby places below; the airport is about 23 km (39 minutes) away.

Why buyers choose Bang Tao

  • One of Phuket's longest beaches
  • Boat Avenue, Porto de Phuket and beach clubs
  • International schools and clinics nearby
  • Next to the Laguna Phuket resort area

Neighbouring areas in our catalogue: Laguna · Layan · Cherng Talay

Location

Open larger map

Lifestyle and amenities

Bang Tao has a cosmopolitan feel, with cafes, restaurants, gyms, co-working spaces and international supermarkets. It is busy in high season but remains more residential than Patong.

Beaches and surroundings

Bang Tao Beach runs for several kilometres, with resorts, beach clubs and quieter sections. It is calm for swimming in the dry season and gets waves during the monsoon.

Rental demand in Bang Tao

Bang Tao has both a strong holiday-rental market and solid long-term demand from families and remote workers. The amount of new supply is high, so differentiation matters.

Short-term holiday rentals

Units within walking distance of the beach or Boat Avenue let best; high season is roughly November to April.

Long-term rentals

Steady demand from families with children at nearby international schools and from long-stay professionals.

Typical tenants

Families, couples, remote workers and holidaymakers.

Suitable property types

One- and two-bedroom condos with resort facilities; three- and four-bedroom pool villas for families.

Advantages and limitations

Advantage: demand from both tourists and residents. Limitations: many new condos compete for the same tenants; traffic on the main roads in high season.

General market observations, not verified statistics. No rental income or occupancy is guaranteed; developer-advertised returns are not market results.

Rental and investment in Bang Tao

Bang Tao is one of Phuket's main areas for new-build condos and villas. Buyers like the mix of beach lifestyle, schools and services; the key question is how a specific project stands out from nearby supply.

Typical investor profiles

Buyers of off-plan condos, families buying villas, holiday-home owners who rent out part of the year.

Risks to consider

Large pipeline of new projects, construction delays and differences in management quality between buildings.

Ownership costs

Common fees, sinking fund, management commission, utilities between tenants and maintenance.

Bang Tao: frequently asked questions

Is Bang Tao a good area to buy property in Phuket?

Bang Tao is popular with families and investors because of its beach, international community, schools and services. Supply of new projects is high, so compare location, developer and management carefully.

How long is Bang Tao Beach?

Bang Tao Beach is one of the longest on Phuket's west coast, several kilometres from Surin to Layan.

What is the difference between Bang Tao and Laguna?

Laguna Phuket is a gated integrated resort with hotels, golf and lagoons inside the wider Bang Tao area. Our Bang Tao vs Laguna guide explains it.

How far is Bang Tao from the airport?

Our project data puts Bang Tao projects about 16 to 23 km from Phuket International Airport, usually 25 to 35 minutes by car.

Are there international schools near Bang Tao?

Yes, several international schools and kindergartens are within a short drive; our project pages list distances to specific schools.

Is there long-term rental demand in Bang Tao?

Yes, from families, remote workers and long-stay residents, as well as seasonal holiday demand. Actual results depend on the unit, price and management.

How much does property in Bang Tao cost?

Advertised starting prices for projects in Bang Tao run from ฿2,906,700 to ฿39,800,000 (13 of 13 projects publish a price). These are lowest advertised prices; ask us to confirm current availability.
